commit 094bb832dd434efda0bd50f282e810206cb7917a
Author:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Sun Nov 9 14:16:03 2025 +0000
Commit:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Sun Nov 9 14:16:03 2025 +0000

    Bug 1997599 - Port bug 1926287: Add Ubuntu 24.04 as test platform. r=coreycb
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D270861

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/docker-image/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/docker-image/kind.yml
index 703cd422536..89b84518249 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/docker-image/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/docker-image/kind.yml
@@ -46,8 +46,13 @@ reference-tasks:
     - ubuntu2204-packages
     - ubuntu2204-base
     - ubuntu2404-base
-    - ubuntu2404-raw
+    - ubuntu2404-build-python
+    - ubuntu2404-i386-packages
+    - ubuntu2404-i386-raw
     - ubuntu2404-packages
+    - ubuntu2404-raw
+    - ubuntu2404-test
+    - ubuntu2404-test-base
     - update-verify
 
 transforms:
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/test/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/test/kind.yml
index 633dbc40dac..77295f42d99 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/test/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/test/kind.yml
@@ -38,6 +38,10 @@ task-defaults:
                 skip-unless-backstop: null
             default:
                 never: null
+    docker-image:
+        by-test-platform:
+            linux2404-.*: {in-tree: ubuntu2404-test}
+            default: {in-tree: ubuntu1804-test}
     mozharness:
         requires-signed-builds:
             by-test-platform:
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/test/test-platforms.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/test/test-platforms.yml
index d3a73278c4d..6d839e03b30 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/test/test-platforms.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/test/test-platforms.yml
@@ -16,7 +16,7 @@
 # generation.
 
 ##
-# Linux platforms (matching /linux.*/)
+# Linux platforms (Ubuntu 18.04, matching /linux.*/)
 
 linux1804-64-qr/opt:
     build-platform: linux64/opt
@@ -61,6 +61,52 @@ linux1804-64-ccov-qr/opt:
         - mochitest-tests
         - xpcshell-tests
 
+##
+# Linux platforms (Ubuntu 24.04, matching /linux.*/, no -qr)
+
+linux2404-64/opt:
+    build-platform: linux64/opt
+    test-sets:
+        - gtest-tests
+        - marionette-tests
+        - mochitest-tests
+        - xpcshell-tests
+
+linux2404-64-shippable/opt:
+    build-platform: linux64-shippable/opt
+    test-sets:
+        - gtest-tests
+        - marionette-tests
+        - mochitest-tests
+        - xpcshell-tests
+
+linux2404-64/debug:
+    build-platform: linux64/debug
+    test-sets:
+        - gtest-tests
+        - marionette-tests
+        - mochitest-tests
+        - xpcshell-tests
+
+linux2404-64-asan/opt:
+    build-platform: linux64-asan/opt
+    test-sets:
+        - mochitest-tests
+        - xpcshell-tests
+
+linux2404-64-tsan/opt:
+    build-platform: linux64-tsan/opt
+    test-sets:
+        - mochitest-tests
+        - xpcshell-tests
+
+linux2404-64-ccov/opt:
+    build-platform: linux64-ccov/opt
+    test-sets:
+        - marionette-tests
+        - mochitest-tests
+        - xpcshell-tests
+
 ##
 # Windows platforms (matching /windows.*/) 24H2 (no -qr)
 
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml
index e75f416b3e5..d0b7152532d 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml
@@ -49,10 +49,10 @@ xpcshell:
             default: 5
     timeoutfactor:
         by-test-platform:
-            linux1804-64-asan-qr/opt: 2
-            linux1804-64-ccov-qr/opt: 4
-            linux1804-64-tsan-qr/opt: 3
-            linux1804-64/debug: 2
+            linux.*64-asan-qr/opt: 2
+            linux.*64-ccov-qr/opt: 4
+            linux.*64-tsan-qr/opt: 3
+            linux.*64/debug: 2
             macosx1015-64.*: 6
             macosx1470-64/debug: 6
             macosx1470-64.*/opt: 4
title: Bug 1997599 - Port bug 1926287: Add Ubuntu 24.04 as test platform. r=coreycb
